newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary bourse to start BUBOR futures on Sept 19.
newsitem.headline: Hungary bourse to start BUBOR futures on Sept 19.

text.p: The Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) said on Thursday that it will introduce futures contracts for one-month and three-month Budapest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) contracts as of September 19.
The step is in harmony with the decision of the BCE's Financial Section on September 2, it said.
One-month and three-month BUBOR rates are fixed daily by the National Bank of Hungary on its Reuters page.
